series: Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, Reason #27 (the middle)
hook: Goals don't die at the start. They die in the middle.

gate.goal_link: any long goal (a year of Spanish): motivation sags halfway

gate.universal: halfway through something big and losing steam

frame.obstacle: one finish line a year away
frame.fix: twelve monthly finish lines (month 1: order dinner in Spanish); count what's done in the first half, what's left in the second
